newsitem.title: USA: Eagle sees Ernst woes helping sales.
newsitem.headline: Eagle sees Ernst woes helping sales.

text.p: Eagle Hardware and Garden Inc President Richard Takata said the company expects its same-store sales numbers to benefit from the financial troubles of rival Ernst Home Center Inc in overlapping areas.

Takata declined to give specific details, but said that by way of understanding the magnitude of the impact for same- store sales in these locations, he said stores that might normally have grown by 10 percent would experience "20 percent or better" same store sales growth.
Takata also said Eagle plans to have opened seven to eight new stores by the end of fiscal year 1997.

He noted Ernst had earlier closed 25 locations and although only one of eight additional stores it recently said it was closing was in an area of direct competition, about 60 percent of the 53 remaining locations overlap.
Same store sales rose 12 percent in the second quarter for the home improvement warehouse company, with stores in Alaska, Colorado, Hawaii, Montana, Oregon, Utah and Washington.
